title: Organic Chemistry, 4.1 Naming Cycloalkanes
text:
Saturated cyclic hydrocarbons are called cycloalkanes, or alicyclic compounds (aliphatic cyclic). Because cycloalkanes consist of rings of −CH_2−units, they have the general formula (CH_2)_n, or C_nH_2n, and can be represented by polygons in skeletal drawings.
Substituted cycloalkanes are named by rules similar to those we saw in (Section 3.4) for open-chain alkanes. For most compounds, there are only two steps.
